newsitem.title: GREECE: WHITE HOUSE'S MONIZ WILL LECTURE TONIGHT ON SCIENCE.
newsitem.headline: WHITE HOUSE'S MONIZ WILL LECTURE TONIGHT ON SCIENCE.

text.p: The associate director of the White House Office for science and technology policy, MIT professor E.J.Moniz, will give a lecture on science and the future tonight, the US Information Service said in a statement.

The lecture entitled "Enabling the future: Science in the international interest" will be delivered at the main ceremonial hall of the University of Athens, 30 Panepistimiou street, at 1800 local, it said.

The speech is part of the N.Christofilos Lecture Series and is organised by the University of Athens, the National Technical University of Athens and the Institute of accelerating systems and applications. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
